'''Aztin Maru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Maru was part of [[Vladlun's gang]], a minor criminal group led by [[Vladlun Travan]].<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dabrini and two other associates of Travan, [[Titus Dabrini]] and [[Tiaba Charr]], had earned a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] therefore traveled to Rori in order to collect the bounties for the three criminals. However, after tracking them to [[Vladlun Travan's Hideout]], Fett decided to let a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was investigating the bunker do his dirty work and take out the bounty targets. Aztin Maru was finally killed by the spacer.<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aztin Maru was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aztin Maru was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
